payload.description: Most people use AI to work faster. But the highest-leverage moves aren't about speed — they're about multiplying your team and sharpening your judgment. This guide covers two underrated AI strategies from Nathan Mapp, CPA: using AI to uplift everyone around you, and using AI to stress-test your own thinking.
payload.name: Two AI Power Moves Most People Overlook
payload.title: Two AI Power Moves Most People Overlook
